description:
epac puts Canada's federal Parliament in your pocket. Track how your MP votes on every bill, read Hansard debates in a clean chat format, and hold your representative accountable — all from verified official sources.

KNOW YOUR MP
• See every vote your MP has cast, with Yea/Nay results and the final outcome
• Read how often they speak in the House and on which subjects
• Check their quarterly travel, hospitality, and contract spending
• View who lobbied them through the Commissioner of Lobbying registry
• Deep-link to Elections Canada for their electoral history

FOLLOW WHAT MATTERS
• Follow specific bills from introduction to Royal Assent
• Subscribe to topics you care about: housing, healthcare, environment, and more
• Get notified when your MP votes or speaks on issues you follow
• Follow multiple MPs, ridings, or parties for a broader picture

UNDERSTAND PARLIAMENT
• Browse House of Commons Hansard debates in an easy-to-read chat format
• Search across all sittings for debates on any topic
• View the Order Paper — what's scheduled before Parliament sits
• Track e-Petitions from the House of Commons
• See vote-speech cross-references: which debates led to which votes

CIVIC ACTION TOOLS
• Contact your MP directly with pre-written templates tied to specific votes
• Share any vote with a verified source citation for fact-checking
• Access open government consultations to have your say on policy
• View political party financing and annual contribution limits

DATA SOURCES
epac uses only verified official sources: ourcommons.ca for Hansard, votes, and member information; openparliament.ca; Elections Canada for electoral data; Statistics Canada 2021 Census for riding demographics; and the Commissioner of Lobbying's public registry.

YOUR PRIVACY
epac does not require an account. Your postal code lookup and topic preferences stay on your device. No data is sold or shared.

Canada's Parliament belongs to all Canadians. epac makes it accessible.
